boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost places and activities for Florida Atlantic students, spanning campus gaming, public art, aquariums, and nature trails.

cards.entity_name: PC Gaming at the Florida Atlantic Esports Arena
cards.title: Queue Up for PC Gaming
cards.subtitle: Florida Atlantic Esports Arena and Gaming Center · Student Union
cards.notes: Bring your Owl Card to check out a gaming station and equipment; choose a free-to-play title or a game you already own.
cards.short_summary: Play on one of the arena’s high-performance gaming PCs without paying an equipment or access fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic states that every Esports Arena feature is completely free for FAU students with an Owl Card; its stations include gaming PCs and free equipment checkout.
cards.source_title: eSports Arena and Gaming Center | Florida Atlantic University
cards.access_notes: Available only to FAU students; present an Owl Card. Fall hours listed as noon–10 p.m. daily and may change for events or holidays.

cards.entity_name: Console Gaming at the Florida Atlantic Esports Arena
cards.title: Claim a Console Screen
cards.subtitle: Florida Atlantic Esports Arena and Gaming Center · Student Union
cards.notes: Meet friends at one of the five large console-gaming screens, and bring your Owl Card for the arena’s free student access.
cards.short_summary: Settle in for a multiplayer console session on the arena’s 65-inch displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic identifies five 65-inch television screens for console gaming and says all arena features are completely free to FAU students with an Owl Card.
cards.source_title: eSports Arena and Gaming Center | Florida Atlantic University
cards.access_notes: FAU-student access requires an Owl Card. Fall hours are listed as noon–10 p.m. daily but can change for events and holidays.

cards.entity_name: Pool at the Florida Atlantic Esports Arena
cards.title: Start a Pool Match
cards.subtitle: Florida Atlantic Esports Arena and Gaming Center · Student Union
cards.notes: Bring an FAU friend and your Owl Card, then use the arena’s pool tables for an easy no-purchase break between classes.
cards.short_summary: Challenge another Owl to a free game of billiards inside the Student Union gaming center.
cards.evidence_claim: The official arena page lists pool tables among its features and states that all features are completely free to any FAU student who provides an Owl Card.
cards.source_title: eSports Arena and Gaming Center | Florida Atlantic University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to FAU students with an Owl Card; equipment is subject to availability and arena house rules.

cards.entity_name: Table Tennis at the Florida Atlantic Esports Arena
cards.title: Trade Table-Tennis Rallies
cards.subtitle: Florida Atlantic Esports Arena and Gaming Center · Student Union
cards.notes: Ask a classmate to join a quick table-tennis match, and have your Owl Card ready for the free student equipment checkout.
cards.short_summary: Turn a study break into a no-cost table-tennis match at the campus gaming center.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic lists ping pong among the arena’s activities and says every arena feature and equipment checkout is free for FAU students with an Owl Card.
cards.source_title: eSports Arena and Gaming Center | Florida Atlantic University
cards.access_notes: FAU students must show an Owl Card. Check availability on arrival and follow the arena’s posted equipment rules.

cards.entity_name: Board Games at the Florida Atlantic Esports Arena
cards.title: Open a Board Game
cards.subtitle: Florida Atlantic Esports Arena and Gaming Center · Student Union
cards.notes: Gather a small group at the arena’s game tables, show your Owl Card, and select an available board game without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: Share a screen-free game session in the Student Union’s dedicated gaming space.
cards.evidence_claim: The arena’s official page identifies board-game tables and states that all arena features are completely free for FAU students upon presentation of an Owl Card.
cards.source_title: eSports Arena and Gaming Center | Florida Atlantic University
cards.access_notes: Limited to FAU students with an Owl Card; game selection and table availability can vary.

cards.title: Walk Through the Schmidt Gallery
cards.subtitle: University Galleries · Florida Atlantic Boca Raton campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition schedule, then meet inside the Schmidt Center Gallery for a public art outing with no ticket required.
cards.short_summary: Browse changing contemporary-art exhibitions at FAU’s principal university gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Atlantic’s University Galleries page states that admission to all its exhibitions and programs is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: About The Galleries | Florida Atlantic University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. Consult the University Galleries schedule before visiting because exhibition dates and gallery hours vary.

cards.entity_name: Gumbo Limbo Nature Center Marine Aquariums
cards.title: Watch the Marine Aquariums
cards.subtitle: Gumbo Limbo Nature Center · 1801 North Ocean Boulevard
cards.notes: Visit during nature-center hours, move slowly between the outdoor tanks, and leave time for the FAU Visitors’ Gallery.
cards.short_summary: Observe coastal marine life together at Boca Raton’s admission-free nature center.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Boca Raton states that Gumbo Limbo Nature Center charges no general admission and publishes hours for its nature center and aquariums.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Gumbo Limbo Nature Center
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; donations are optional. Aquariums follow posted center hours and outdoor facilities close when lightning is nearby.

cards.title: Walk the Daggerwing Boardwalk
cards.subtitle: Burt Aaronson South County Regional Park · West Boca Raton
cards.notes: Walk the two boardwalk trails at an easy pace, pause at the benches, and watch the swamp canopy for birds and butterflies.
cards.short_summary: Share a short wildlife walk along an accessible boardwalk through natural swampland.
cards.evidence_claim: Palm Beach County says visitors do not pay admission to enjoy Daggerwing Nature Center’s 0.6-mile, two-trail boardwalk.
cards.source_title: Parks & Recreation Nature Trails | Palm Beach County
cards.access_notes: The admission-free boardwalk is open sunrise–sunset. Pets, food, alcohol, running, biking, skating, smoking, and fishing are prohibited.

cards.title: Loop Pondhawk’s Trails
cards.subtitle: Beside Spanish River Library · 1501 Spanish River Boulevard
cards.notes: Enter through the library parking lot, choose a marked trail, and regroup at the covered wetland observation platform.
cards.short_summary: Walk or bike around Blue Lake and restored wetlands at a public natural area.
cards.evidence_claim: Palm Beach County identifies Pondhawk as a public-use natural area, and its natural-areas guidance says these lands are free for passive activities including hiking and birdwatching.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise–sunset every day. Enter via the Spanish River Library lot; natural-area rules prohibit pets, drones, and alcohol.

cards.title: Meet at the Boca Aquarium
cards.subtitle: 2801 North Federal Highway · Boca Raton
cards.notes: Stop in during posted hours to see the shark, reef, nano-reef, and seahorse tanks; Thursday afternoons include shark feeding.
cards.short_summary: Take a compact, admission-free aquarium break a short drive from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Boca Aquarium’s official visitor page states that admission is always free and lists its tanks, hours, address, and Thursday shark feeding.
cards.access_notes: Free admission Monday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday. Groups of 12 or more should contact the aquarium in advance.
